entries.title: Exchange
entries.description: Semantic interchange using stable portable IDs, schema-valid submissions, explicit references, provenance, and lossless unknown preservation.
required_machinery: stable Record, Link, and Blob IDs generated before transfer
schema-valid submissions with provenance and explicit references
unknown objects, fields, and semantics preserved inertly or refused
scoped Capsule exchange with dependency and losslessness reporting
entries.claim: Another application can understand and ingest the transferred assertions without silently changing their identity or meaning.
exclusions: does not claim canonical bytes, commitments, or portable object hashes
does not claim producer authenticity merely because provenance is present

entries.title: Canonical Store
entries.description: Canonical portable objects with split compartments, JCS, commitments, hashes, local atomic storage, origin idempotency, and exact availability states.
required_machinery: all Exchange requirements
ccf-jcs-sha256-v2 canonicalization and hash vectors
structural and semantic compartments with random salts and commitments
portable object hashes independent of archive admission coordinates
atomic local storage and exact origin idempotency
distinct present, withheld, erased, and external availability states
entries.claim: The same portable canonical object has the same commitments and object hash everywhere.
exclusions: does not claim signed archive history
does not claim rollback detection or newest-head freshness
does not require policy evaluation or bitemporal lineages

entries.title: Verified Archive
entries.description: Signed genesis and commit history, Merkle membership, catalog pinning, verifiable import/export, restore, and foreign merge.
required_machinery: all Canonical Store requirements
signed genesis and append-only commit journal
Merkle membership and admission correspondence
semantic-catalog pinning
mindpack restore and foreign merge with custody proofs
entries.claim: The archive has valid-prefix integrity and its presented history has not been mutated.
exclusions: does not claim the presented head is newest without an independent witness
does not require producer signing unless the signed-producer-sync capability is declared
does not claim reproducible governance decisions

entries.title: Governed Archive
entries.description: Reproducible policy, bitemporal lineages, generation fences, erasure and suppression, consequential receipts, and projection rebuild behavior.
required_machinery: all Verified Archive requirements
pinned policy evaluator and consequential decision receipts
bitemporal compare-and-swap state lineages
generation fences and pending-state liveness
erasure, suppression, and non-resurrection behavior
destructive projection deletion and canonical rebuild conformance
entries.claim: Policy, erasure, and consequential decisions are reproducible at a pinned archive state.
exclusions: deletion assurance is limited to separately declared encryption and erasure capabilities
operator resistance is not implied without a deployment-specific security capability
newest-head freshness is not implied without witnessed integrity
